usageNotes: Use this endpoint to add or re-enable a standard Proxmox-defined APT repository on a target node by its handle string (e.g. 'pve-no-subscription', 'pbs-enterprise'). If the repository is already present but disabled, calling this re-enables it rather than creating a duplicate entry. Pass the current config digest to guard against concurrent modifications — obtain the digest first via GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories.

examples.summary: Enable the no-subscription Proxmox Datacenter Manager repository on a node

tips: Fetch the current digest with GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories before writing, then pass it in the request to prevent race conditions.
The 'handle' refers to Proxmox-defined standard repository identifiers — it is not a free-form URL or sources.list entry. Only handles recognized by the PDM node are valid.
After adding or enabling a repository, run GET /nodes/{node}/apt/update (or POST to trigger an apt-get update) so the package index reflects the newly enabled source.
The node must be online and reachable by PDM; this call operates directly on that node's APT configuration.
